contents: Unmodified voice runtime, committed profile, setup script, voice docs and licenses; desktop app excluded

local_modifications.services/voice_runtime/tts_service.py: CUDA bf16 support check; float32 for Pascal; SDPA attention; optional native Metal model loading on macOS with PyTorch fallback.
local_modifications.services/voice_runtime/tts_metal.py: Local adapter for qwentts-cpp-python 0.5.0: original BF16 talker and float32 codec, pinned GGUF revision, existing Iris speaker embedding and ICL acoustic references.
local_modifications.services/voice_runtime/app.py: Serialize WAV synthesis for a single 6GB GPU; warm installed Metal models before serving requests; expose loaded buffered TTS backend in health.
local_modifications.LICENSE.md: Replace two unbundled-document relative links with verified upstream commit permalinks; license text unchanged.
